summaryZh: Daugherty 实验室研究宿主免疫基因如何演化以抵抗病原体，以及病原体如何反向演化突破免疫。团队结合比较基因组学、生物化学和病毒学。
researchQuestions: 宿主免疫基因如何演化以抵御病原体？
病原体如何演化以对抗并突破宿主免疫？
topics: 宿主与病原体共同演化

evidence.quote: The Daugherty lab in the Division of Biological Sciences at UCSD uses comparative genomics, biochemistry and virology to understand how host immunity genes evolve to defend against pathogens and how pathogens counter-evolve to defeat host immunity.
